conventions.item: Standard deviation of x in the E4 signal (section 4): sample or population.
conventions.resolution: Sample standard deviation (ddof = 1), the convention of round 2's Sharpe ratio and of a rolling standard deviation with a minimum count; --sd-ddof 0 switches. The run counts the formation days on which the other convention changes a book's longs or shorts and, if any, recomputes E4 over round 2's window with it (diagnostics.sd_ddof_alternative).

conventions.item: A day with trades but without taker buys or without taker sells gives x = ln(0) or ln(infinity).
conventions.resolution: Such an x counts as not present, like a day without trades (so it neither enters the standard deviation's count of 20 nor the seven-day sum). The run counts such days inside the 37-day look-backs of band members on formation days (diagnostics.nonfinite_x); zero makes the choice moot.

conventions.item: Ties in the signal (section 4, 'ties by symbol order').
conventions.resolution: Names sorted ascending on (signal, symbol order); the q lowest are sold and the q highest, taken from the end of that order, bought (verify_cse's convention). The run counts formation days with an exact tie across a quintile boundary (diagnostics.signal_boundary_ties).

conventions.item: Ties in the volume ranking ('ties broken by symbol order').
conventions.resolution: Ranked on (-median volume, symbol order): the earlier symbol takes the better rank. The run counts days with an exact tie across the rank boundaries 20/21, 50/51, 100/101 and 200/201.
Days k - 30 to k - 1, with the ranks of those days (past ranks only).

conventions.item: The Fama-MacBeth regressions of section 6 rule 3.
conventions.resolution: OLS of the winsorised seven-day forward return P(01:00, k + 7) / P(01:00, k) - 1 (last traded price for a dying series) on a constant and the three scaled ranks (order flow first, then the 7- and 21-day returns from 00:00 of day k - 7 or k - 21 to 00:00 of day k), N being the cross-section's size; weeks with fewer than 40 names are skipped; t = mean / (sample sd / sqrt(weeks)).

conventions.item: The Newey-West t of the intercept (section 5).
conventions.resolution: V = (X'X)^-1 S (X'X)^-1 with S = sum_t u_t u_t' + sum_{j=1,2} (1 - j/3) sum_t (u_t u_{t-j}' + u_{t-j} u_t'), u_t = x_t e_t, x_t = (1, reference's month t), no n / (n - k) factor; t = a / sqrt(V_aa). With a constant only it reduces to the monthly test's t.

conventions.item: The null's jumps (section 5): 'a mean of six times the GARCH part's daily standard deviation'.
conventions.resolution: Six times the unconditional standard deviation (1), constant, outside the variance recursion, which gives the stated null standard deviation of 1.48; --selftest checks this null against the pre-registration's critical values (2.07 for B's 43 months at 5%, 2.89 and 2.49 for D's 24 and 48 months at 2.5%) and its median monthly skewness (-1.07 over 43 months).

conventions.item: Draws of the intercept test's null.
conventions.resolution: New draws of the monthly test's null with their own seed (the pre-registration's separate seed for the intercept implies separate draws), each regressed on the observed reference series.

conventions.item: Units of the 1e-9 tolerance of section 6 for the two means of rule 3.
conventions.resolution: Not stated. The means are written both in bp a day and as fractions of capital a day, at full precision, so that either reading can be applied.

conventions.item: Mean net return without the best calendar month.
conventions.resolution: The month with the largest sum of daily net returns is removed and the mean taken over the other days (verify_cse's convention, which matched round 2's official run).

verify_cse's conventions, which matched round 2's net results: hourly equity with longs at the bar low and shorts at the bar high, funding paid before the bar opens, net of the sub-portfolio's own entry cost before netting and of the delisting exits it paid; the loss to minus its capital is booked as price in the interval of the liquidation hour; no exit cost for a liquidated sub-portfolio, whose scheduled exits leave the netting. Round 2's official code splits price and funding differently in that interval (POST_RESULTS.md), which leaves the net unchanged.

conventions.item: The reference book E4-top100 over B's window.
conventions.resolution: Rebuilt from B's first formation day (1 March 2023), so it ramps up over B's first six intervals; from 8 March 2023 it equals E4 over round 2's window day by day (checked by the run).
Upper end of the 95% stationary-bootstrap interval of the daily net Sharpe ratio at 1x (10,000 draws, mean block 30 days, this script's seed).
Calendar years, over the window's days that fall in each year.

conventions.item: Skewness of the monthly returns (descriptive, section 5, against the null's quantiles of section 8).
conventions.resolution: Both the population g1 and the adjusted G1 = g1 sqrt(n (n - 1)) / (n - 2) are reported; the null's quantiles are of G1, which reproduces section 8's -1.07 (-2.14, -0.10) over 43 months while g1 gives -1.03.

conventions.item: The taker-buy quote volume column of perp/*.parquet (round 2's verifier did not read it).
conventions.resolution: Found by name, taker_buy_quote_volume first, else the only column naming both 'taker' and 'quote'; the column used is recorded in data.taker_columns.

verification_targets.tolerance_note: Section 6: t-statistics of rules 1 and 2, the two means of rule 3 and the Sharpe ratio of rule 4 within 1e-9; the sign of the mean Fama-MacBeth slope and the side of 1.0 of its t; each p-value within 0.002.
